title: Minimal objective ablation after Phase G action-target audit
evidence_basis: Historical V3 positive control: 13/20 under recovered protocol.
Trainer-side replay audit: 160/160 episodes readable with matching state/action/task/image structures.
Phase G action-target audit: 101660 frames, bounded finite actions, no single loader or collapsed-channel defect.

A_terminal_window_weighting.change: Increase loss weight only for the final 20 percent of each episode, with a fresh output directory and unchanged model/data/evaluator settings.
A_terminal_window_weighting.strength: Directly targets the late-stage placement/release failure hypothesis.
A_terminal_window_weighting.risk: The audit did not prove that terminal targets are underrepresented; may overfit episode ends.
A_terminal_window_weighting.recommendation: recommended if a new training run is explicitly approved

B_temporal_smoothness_regularizer.change: Add a penalty on action differences across adjacent target frames.
B_temporal_smoothness_regularizer.risk: May smooth away the demonstrated one-to-two-frame gripper transition and alter the task objective.

C_data_reweighting_by_release_event.change: Oversample or upweight chunks containing gripper sign transitions.
C_data_reweighting_by_release_event.strength: Uses the demonstrated release event as a direct training signal.
C_data_reweighting_by_release_event.risk: 395 sign changes are distributed across task groups; event detection and chunk-boundary semantics need a new validator.
C_data_reweighting_by_release_event.recommendation: defer until event/chunk semantics are independently validated

recommended_path.why: It is the smallest targeted change aligned with the observed late-stage failure, while leaving state preprocessing, action semantics, evaluator, and dataset contents unchanged.
recommended_path.minimum_experiment: One fresh training output directory, one fixed seed, same 90k-step budget and optimizer, then strict task-0 evaluation at 30k/60k/90k using the calibrated evaluator.
recommended_path.success_gate: Do not claim improvement from loss alone; require nonzero strict success and an improvement over the 0/15 repair baseline on the predeclared task-0 seeds, with no evaluator/runtime errors.
